title: Dev - I Version 3.2.0 User Settings will not be written to the Pump
body: In the Dana I tab, User Settings, the values are not written to the pump. The button seems to be inactive.

comments.body: Same here. No changes are send to pump. Changes made at the pump are not shown in the Dana tab...even after refresh of Bluetooth connection.

Confirmed

This bug has existed for a long time now, across multiple dev versions.
